turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ah, it's been a long day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm in Lisbon for three days and I don't want to eat at tourist traps.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good instinct. Would you rather wander a food market and try lots of little things, or book one really good local restaurant?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Has she had her bath already, Rohan?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One moment, my sister is asking me something. Please don't interrupt until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Be honest, does this tree look weird to you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A little. The trunk is kind of thick at the top.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, you're right. Should I just paint over it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No, just thin it out a bit. The leaves look really nice though.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks. I spent forever on those leaves.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It shows. Hang it in the hallway when it's done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, I'm back. Sorry about that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Your Lisbon food plan is still open. Market or a sit-down place?
